newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES END MIXED IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES END MIXED IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.

text.p: Three stocks rose, two fell and four were flat in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Friday.
Turnover rose to 1.5 million zlotys from 0.9 million zlotys on Thursday.
NFI units rose to 138.5 zlotys in a 19-million -zloty turnover.
The continuous trading system, which currently lists 15 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 65 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks rose and the main market's index rose 1.3 percent.
